nodes.text: At strict T0, can train-only historical reactions be used only when their credible net benefit over content-only prediction is positive?

nodes.population: Frozen CSMV content units under the registered split and evidence boundary
nodes.treatment_or_exposure: Credible posterior OOF net-benefit routing versus the strongest eligible point/generic router
nodes.outcome: Per-video Jensen-Shannon divergence at matched 90% answer coverage
nodes.randomization_unit: training run seed for algorithmic variation only
nodes.unit_mismatch_rationale_if_units_differ: Seeds and folds are not inferential sample units

nodes.measurement_instrument: Frozen Task20 JSD evaluator plus matched-coverage action ledger
nodes.minimally_meaningful_effect: Any reproducible reduction whose paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound is below zero; no restored 3/5/8 percent gate
nodes.missingness_policy: Invalid or unavailable history falls back to content-only and is counted; no silent row deletion

nodes.text: Credible negative-transfer-rate difference, tested only after P1 passes

nodes.method: Video-level paired bootstrap confidence intervals with fixed-sequence claim gating; Holm for the three source-specific ablations
nodes.assumptions: Registered content-unit pairing, no target-response leakage, eligible exchangeability claims limited to the empirical distribution protocol
nodes.multiplicity: Fixed sequence H2a Oracle -> H2b JSD -> H2b negative transfer -> H2c; Holm alpha 0.05 within three-source ablations
nodes.independence_assumption: Inference is over native content units; comments, folds, thinning replicates and seeds are not independent n

nodes.text: No Oracle headroom, no advantage over point/generic routing, no natural-OOD harm reduction, source non-identifiability, or any OOF/index/test leakage

baseline_fairness.data: Same CSMV revision, split, T0 input and train-only candidate pool
baseline_fairness.compute: Same maximum trials, seeds, early stopping and backbone predictions
baseline_fairness.tuning: DEV_SELECT only; calibration and coverage thresholds on disjoint DEV_CALIBRATE
baseline_fairness.evaluation_protocol: Same evaluator, matched 90% coverage, video-level paired analysis

authorization.scope: Task40 development preregistration only; no formal test
